evals.prompt: Set up a new Python project called orders in this empty directory, with the usual tooling. It's a small CLI that prices customer orders.
evals.expected_output: A uv package scaffolded per references/init.md, with every baseline file in place and `uv run poe check` passing.
expectations: pyproject.toml uses the uv_build build backend and requires-python is 3.12 or newer
main() lives in src/orders/cli.py, src/orders/__init__.py holds only a docstring, and [project.scripts] points at orders.cli:main
tests/test_cli.py exists and there is no __init__.py under tests/
[tool.basedpyright] typeCheckingMode is standard
CONTRIBUTING.md exists and does not start with a frontmatter block
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .pre-commit-config.yaml, devbox.json, .vscode/settings.json, scripts/check_file_length.py, and scripts/changed_lines_coverage.py exist
`sync-pyproject` in report mode says the project matches the baseline
`uv run poe check` passes

evals.prompt: This project still uses pip and requirements files. Move it onto uv and the standard tooling. You don't need to wait for my approval on the plan - make the changes and tell me what you did.
evals.expected_output: The project is on uv with code under src/, following references/adopt.md, and the existing code's lint, typecheck, and coverage counts are reported instead of mass-fixed.
expectations: The package code moved from orders/ to src/orders/, and src/orders/__init__.py keeps its original docstring instead of a generated main() stub
No [project.scripts] entry points at a main() that does not exist
Relative imports (`from .models import Order`) were rewritten as absolute `orders.` imports
pydantic is in [project] dependencies and pytest is in the dev dependency group
black is not a dependency, and no [tool.black] table exists
The response reports lint, typecheck, and coverage counts for the existing code and suggests an order to fix them
The existing code was not mass-fixed: missing docstrings, annotations, and keyword-only parameters in the original modules remain unless an autofix added them

evals.prompt: Review this project against your Python project baseline. Don't change anything yet - just tell me where it drifts.
evals.expected_output: A report in the review.md template covering config drift, missing files, and code conventions, with no files changed.
expectations: No file in the project was created, modified, or deleted
The report names the tool.pyright CONFLICT and says to move its settings to [tool.basedpyright]
The report names the obsolete tool.ruff.target-version
The report lists max-complexity 15 as DIFFERS, recommends 10, and asks whether 15 is deliberate
The report lists too-many-branches as an ignore the project added (RELAXED) and asks whether it is deliberate
The report gives the `uv add --dev` command for the missing basedpyright and vulture
The report lists CONTRIBUTING.md, AGENTS.md, and .pre-commit-config.yaml as missing
The Conventions section gives a file:line for each of the os.path use, the positional call to order_total, and a public function without a bare `*`
The report uses the review.md headings: Config drift, Files, Conventions, Suggested order

evals.prompt: Bump this project's type checking up to strict.
evals.expected_output: Strict mode set through sync-pyproject and enforced by pre-commit, per references/typing-mode.md, with the cost of the change reported and the code left unfixed.
expectations: [tool.basedpyright] has typeCheckingMode = "standard" plus strict = ["src"], not typeCheckingMode = "strict"
any-type is no longer in [tool.ruff.lint] ignore
.pre-commit-config.yaml exists and has the typecheck hook running basedpyright
The AGENTS.md Conventions section records the typing mode as strict
The response reports the new findings per tool: basedpyright errors from the untyped list in line_count, and ruff any-type from parse_cents
src/orders/pricing.py is unchanged
The response names pyproject.toml, .pre-commit-config.yaml, and AGENTS.md as the files changed
